dialog.english:
��������*sigh* How long are we gonna have
to keep doing this...
dialog.translation:
Suspiro... cuánto tiempo más
vamos a seguir así...

dialog.english:
What does that black thing want
with us?
dialog.translation:
Qué quiere esa cosa negra
de nosotros?

dialog.english:
Well, we've got to stop it,
whatever it's doing. Let's look
for clues.
dialog.translation:
Bueno, hay que detenerlo,
sea lo que sea. Busquemos
pistas.

dialog.english: There's someone here!
You're back!
Is he talking to us?

Playing me for a fool, huh? Well,
it's my turn!
dialog.translation:
Me tomas por tonto? Pues
ahora me toca a mí!

dialog.english:
We have *no* idea what you're
talking about!
dialog.translation:
No tenemos ni idea de qué
hablas!

dialog.english: Agumon! Run!
Take that!
Aaaaaaah!
W-Waaaaaaait!
Who are you?

I'm not exactly sure what's going
on, but I think you have him
mistaken for someone else...
dialog.translation:
No sé muy bien qué pasa,
pero creo que lo confundes
con otra persona...

dialog.english:
Tai, get away from there! I'll
take him on!
dialog.translation:
Tai, apártate! Yo me
encargo de él!

dialog.english:
It's okay, Hackmon. Those eyes
don't look like they want to
fight.
dialog.translation:
Calma, Hackmon. Sus ojos
no parecen los de alguien
que quiere pelear

dialog.english:
They look like pretty gentle
eyes...
Looks like I was wrong, then.

I'm Takuya Kanbara. Sorry for
startling you there...
dialog.translation:
Soy Takuya Kanbara. Siento
haberos asustado...

dialog.english: A human?!
A human evolved into a Digimon?
Well, it's kinda like that...

Why'd you attack us all of a
sudden?
dialog.translation:
Por qué nos atacaste
de repente?

dialog.english:
Sorry about that. A while back,
some human with the same Digimon
as you attacked me.
dialog.translation:
Perdón por eso. Hace tiempo,
un humano con el mismo Digimon
que tú me atacó.

dialog.english: There's another one of me?

I guess there's a copy of Agumon
running around too, huh?
dialog.translation:
Supongo que también hay
una copia de Agumon suelta.

dialog.english:
Considering what's happened so
far, I wouldn't be surprised.
dialog.translation:
Con todo lo que ha pasado,
no me sorprendería.

dialog.english:
Anyway, I'm glad we didn't end up
fighting each other for some
stupid reason...
dialog.translation:
Bueno, me alegro de que no
acabáramos peleando por
alguna tontería...

dialog.english:
Yeah, I'm glad we avoided that,
too.
dialog.translation:
Sí, yo también me alegro
de evitarlo.

dialog.english:
I'm guessing you were trapped
here, too. Wanna help us out?
dialog.translation:
Supongo que tú también
estás atrapado. Nos ayudas?

dialog.english: You too, huh? ...Okay, sure!

So, about what you were saying
earlier... a *human* attacked you?
dialog.translation:
Sobre lo que decías antes...
te atacó un humano?

dialog.english:
Hmm... He looked like a middle
school student, and he had an
Agumon with him.
dialog.translation:
Parecía un chico de
secundaria, y llevaba
un Agumon con él.

dialog.english:
But when he did, you were probably
a Digimon at the time...
dialog.translation:
Pero entonces tú serías
un Digimon en ese momento...

dialog.english: Yeah, I was.

A middle school student attacking
a Digimon...
dialog.translation:
Un chico de secundaria
atacando a un Digimon...

dialog.english: What kind of guy was that?

Well, he had a really strong
punch...
dialog.translation:
Bueno, tenía un puñetazo
muy fuerte...

dialog.english:
The last person to hit me that
hard was the goalkeeper, during
one of our matches...
dialog.translation:
La última vez que me pegaron
así de fuerte fue el portero,
en un partido...

dialog.english: Wait, you play soccer, too?
You play?
Yeah, I'm in the soccer club.
Whoa!

I tend to do a lot of heading, so
our goalkeeper tends to punch me a
lot...
dialog.translation:
Remato mucho de cabeza, así
que el portero me suele
pegar bastante...

dialog.english: Been there, done that!

What's soccer? Some kind of human
martial arts?
dialog.translation:
Qué es fútbol? Un tipo de
arte marcial humano?

dialog.english: No, no!
Hey! Who are you?
It's another fake...
All right, let's work together!
*whew* That's over.
We're done with this one!
But now we have to leave Takuya...
dialog.translation:
Ahora hay que dejar
a Takuya...

dialog.english:
We didn't get to see each other
for very long, but I learned a lot
from you guys!
dialog.translation:
No pudimos estar juntos
mucho tiempo, pero aprendí
mucho de vosotros!

dialog.english: I'm glad I met you!

Yeah! It was fun, talking about
soccer!
dialog.translation:
Sí! Fue divertido hablar
de fútbol!

dialog.english: See you, Takuya!
Yeah, let's meet again!

So there's another person here...
well, I'm gonna have to get myself
all fired up!
dialog.translation:
Así que hay alguien más aquí...
pues voy a ponerme
las pilas!

dialog.english: 【Area 1】
【Area 2】
【Area 3】
